reason: I would put it in one group and use the free 30, but with receipts landing every day those are gone in a week or two, before I know if my staff will keep it up. When the bill comes I'd ask why I'm paying $19 or more when someone on staff could just type them into a sheet at the end of the day.
objection: Thirty documents is a few days for us across my work groups. I can't tell yet if this sticks or if it's one more app we stop using after a month, and with that many receipts I'd probably need the $35 plan, not the $19 one.
would_change_my_mind: A free full month, not 30 documents, so I see whether my staff keep using it and whether the Monday report actually catches a duplicate or a wrong total that saves me real money.
